result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks and mature street trees. While a crosswalk is marked across the side street, the main thoroughfare lacks marked crossings and pedestrian signals, creating a gap in the pedestrian network.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk across the main thoroughfare, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main road in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the corner may limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with continuous sidewalks and street lighting, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or highly visible path across the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main road and the side street intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signage
hazards.description: No signage is present to warn drivers of potential pedestrian crossings at this residential junction.

result.summary: The residential street features a continuous sidewalk on the left side but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The wide, straight roadway and lack of crossing aids create an environment where pedestrians must cross unprotected against potentially fast-moving traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible to facilitate safe pedestrian movement across the roadway.
